ai.summary: OpenAI reportedly cut its latest funding-round target to about $20 billion, down from $30 billion, amid a technology-stock selloff and reduced commitments from some investors. The reported target valuation also fell to $1.25 trillion.
ai.title: OpenAI slashes funding target by $10 billion amid tech rout, FT reports

ai.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic committed to a shared website instruction that publishers can use to signal they do not want content used for AI training. The companies expect to roll out support at different times; the standard applies to future training, not content already collected.
ai.title: AI giants promise publishers new way to block some scraping

ai.summary: The U.S. Justice Department is reportedly asking about Nvidia’s proposed $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, including whether the deal could give Nvidia leverage over a major platform for discovering and distributing AI models. The inquiry is not a lawsuit or a finding of wrongdoing, and the deal remains pending regulatory review.
ai.title: DOJ Questions Nvidia's $12.93 Billion Hugging Face Acquisition Over AI Competition

ai.summary: New York enacted restrictions on certain AI companion chatbot behaviors involving minors, with violations potentially subject to fines. The law takes effect January 1, as states expand AI regulation amid concerns about children’s safety.
ai.title: New York enacts ban on 'unsafe' chatbot behavior with kids as states push AI regulation boundaries

ai.summary: S&P revised Meta’s outlook from stable to negative, citing high capital spending and negative free cash flow. The rating action highlights investor concern about the cost of the company’s AI investment drive.
ai.title: S&P downgrades Meta's outlook amid heavy AI spending

ai.summary: Industry executives described AI chip development as increasingly constrained by system-level issues such as connectivity, advanced packaging, manufacturing yield and supply chains—not just raw compute. The report also noted claims that AI-enabled design and verification tools are shortening chip-development cycles.
ai.title: AI semiconductor industry trends: from chips to systems

quantum.summary: IQM reports preparing a GHZ-entangled state across all 54 qubits of its cloud-accessible Emerald superconducting processor. The reported fidelity was 0.516 after readout-error mitigation, a result demonstrating full-chip entanglement but not, by itself, a practical computational advantage.
quantum.title: IQM Verifies Full-Chip Entanglement Across 54-Qubit Emerald Superconducting Processor

quantum.summary: In an interview, Nord Quantique’s CEO described its bosonic-code approach, which stores microwave photons in superconducting cavities to support error correction within a cavity. He said the company’s measured error-correction gain has more than doubled since 2024 and outlined a longer-term target of error rates between 10⁻⁷ and 10⁻⁹ by 2032.
quantum.title: Julien Camirand Lemire (Nord Quantique): One Cavity, One Error-Corrected Qubit

quantum.source: Ground News (summary by Quantum Computing Report)
quantum.summary: Sandia National Laboratories and Quantinuum researchers introduced Logical GST, a protocol for reconstructing a logical single-qubit gate set and characterizing its noise. They demonstrated it using a logical qubit encoded with the [[7,1,3]] Steane code on Quantinuum’s H1-1 system.
quantum.title: Sandia and Quantinuum Introduce Logical Gate Set Tomography to Map Fault-Tolerant Qubit Noise

quantum.summary: A report says IBM researchers connected two 120-qubit Nighthawk processors using superconducting couplers, reporting an average 99% fidelity for quantum-state transfer between chips. The report notes the work is a preprint and has not yet been independently peer reviewed.
quantum.title: IBM Links Two 120-Qubit Nighthawk Chips While Expanding Its AI Agent Toolkit

quantum.summary: Canada became the 39th participating state in the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking. The organization’s plans include European quantum-computing infrastructure integrated with existing supercomputers.
quantum.title: Canada Becomes the 39th Participating State of the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking

quantum.summary: Researchers reported a framework and algorithm for evaluating quantum “magic,” a resource associated with states that are difficult to simulate classically. Their analysis of spin models found that magic can disappear during thermal evolution, with the reported thresholds depending on the system and region examined.
quantum.title: Researchers Find ‘Magic’ Fades Faster Than Entanglement
